intro: Donyal Tovald is a human steward serving in the Royal Library within Stormwind Keep. Under an initiative begun by the young King Anduin Wrynn, he oversees the care of the kingdom's books and works to distribute copies of historical texts to the broader public.

p: Located in the quiet alcoves of the Royal Library wing within Stormwind Keep, Donyal Tovald tends to the kingdom's vast collection of historical accounts, scrolls, and scholarly volumes. While the library primarily serves the nobility and royal court, young King Anduin Wrynn has sponsored an initiative to make knowledge more accessible to ordinary citizens. Tovald handles the preservation and copying of these texts, helping ensure that the lessons and triumphs of the Alliance are not forgotten amidst the kingdom's turbulent political climate.
